versions.changelog:
- Added English-language trigger support: this skill now recognizes and responds to AI learning journaling queries in both Chinese and English, including casual mentions (e.g., "tried Claude today", "learned a new prompting trick").
- Clarified in the description and instructions that English topics—such as AI learning notes, study plans, prompt engineering tips, model/tool reviews, and learning summaries—will trigger this skill.
- No changes to the core functionality or record structure.

ai-learning-journal 1.0.0 – 初始版本发布

- 提供 AI/LLM 学习记录、心得、技巧等结构化记录工具，自动归档为 Markdown 文件
- 支持历史学习回溯、筛选及知识时间线展示
- 根据用户记录提供个性化学习指导和进阶建议
- 可自动生成学习规划和成长路线，覆盖多种AI学习目标
- 实现定期学习总结和知识体系可视化报告
- 支持主动学习咨询，为不同背景用户推荐 AI 学习路径
